digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / OpenAI Responses API migration
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 constructs OpenAIResponsesModel for openai-responses: prefix and emits deprecation warning that openai: will default to Responses API in v2.0

Four rebar code sites (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, _pydantic_ai_known_providers, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, openai:→openai-chat: normalizers) currently block openai-responses: routing even though pydantic-ai accepts it

Contract tests parameterized over openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes assert identical behavior for structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry, and custom-base-URL routing against a mock OpenAI-compatible server

Hosted OpenAI is Responses-ready at the pydantic-ai layer; custom base_url endpoints, gateway/openai, and third-party providers (deepseek, cerebras, moonshotai, heroku) are Chat-Completions-only under the 1.107.2 pin
xai: and groq: prefixes remain UNKNOWN (construction blocked by missing optional package extras; vendor-side /v1/responses support undocumented)
Rebar must normalize openai: strings and update provider resolution/capability maps before migrations can route to openai-responses: in production
